versions.changelog:
- Initial release of DingTalk Bitable API integration skill.
- Supports table management (list, create, get structure, delete).
- Enables record CRUD: query, add, update, delete (with batch operations).
- Includes field management and view management tools.
- Provides clear usage examples and error handling instructions.
- Requires DingTalk Bitable and app access permissions; credentials auto-read from configuration.
